options.name: proactive_vertical_slice_agentic
options.description: OFFLINE / DRY-RUN VARIANT of proactive-vertical-slice.json. The Conscious-layer transform routes its anticipatory decision through an M5.3 LLM transport bridge (proactive.transports.call_transport) so the workflow runs without a real model — the bridge's synthetic echo (dry_run=True) is parsed back into an intent envelope. NOTE: since M5.4 the canonical pattern for LLM-backed Conscious reasoning is to wire an agent_flow node directly (auto-registers as agent.<id> in the Capability Registry, runs through Adversarial → Alignment → handler → Privacy without extra wiring, and gets full Agno features — tools, memory, knowledge, multimodal). This slice predates M5.4; keep it for offline demos when you don't have a model backend, otherwise prefer agent_flow. To use a real transport: register one via /proactive/transports/register, set TRANSPORT_ALIAS in this script's context, and flip DRY_RUN to False.

nodes.script:
# Synthetic source — five fixture emails on a counter.
import time
ctr = int(variables.get("sensor_counter", 0)) + 1
variables["sensor_counter"] = ctr
fixtures = [
    {"from": "alice@example.com", "subject": "Routine status update",
     "body":  "All systems nominal."},
    {"from": "bob@example.com",   "subject": "Card on file",
     "body":  "Please update card 4111111111111111 before Tuesday."},
    {"from": "eve@example.com",   "subject": "URGENT — wire transfer request",
     "body":  "Send $5,000 to acct 9876-1122. ssn 555-12-3456."},
    {"from": "ops@example.com",   "subject": "Calendar reminder",
     "body":  "Meeting Thursday 3pm with the design team."},
    {"from": "news@example.com",  "subject": "Weekly digest",
     "body":  "Five stories worth your time this week."},
]
fx = fixtures[(ctr - 1) % len(fixtures)]
output = {"source": "sensor:synthetic_inbox", "observed_at": time.time(), "payload": fx}

# Sensory: structure the observation. Same shape as the deterministic
# vertical slice — agentic enrichment lives in the Conscious stage below.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
msg  = env.get("payload", {}) or {}
body = str(msg.get("body", ""))
env["observation"] = {
    "observation_type": "email",
    "sender":           msg.get("from"),
    "subject":          msg.get("subject"),
    "body_length":      len(body),
    "summary":          (body[:80] + "…") if len(body) > 80 else body,
}
env["scopes"]     = ["read-only"]
env["confidence"] = 0.95
env["payload"]    = msg
output = env

# Conscious — Anticipatory (AGENTIC variant). Routes the decision
# through an M5.3 LLM transport bridge instead of keyword matching.
# Inputs: TRANSPORT_ALIAS (env var, default "smoke_bridge") +
#          DRY_RUN (env var, default "1" so the workflow runs without
#          a real model). On dry-run, the bridge echoes a synthetic
#          response which we parse heuristically — same end shape as
#          the deterministic version (env["intent"]).
import os
try:
    from proactive import transports as tr
except ImportError:
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive import transports as tr

env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
obs = env.get("observation") or {}

ALIAS   = os.environ.get("NUMEL_PROACTIVE_TRANSPORT",  "smoke_bridge")
DRY_RUN = os.environ.get("NUMEL_PROACTIVE_DRY_RUN",   "1") != "0"

# Lazy-register a default smoke bridge so the workflow doesn't error
# on a fresh state directory. The operator can replace via
# /proactive/transports/register.
_have_alias = False
for _t in tr.list_transports():
    if _t["alias"] == ALIAS:
        _have_alias = True
        break
if not _have_alias:
    tr.register_transport(
        ALIAS,
        kind="openai",
        base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1",
        model="llama3",
        scopes=["external-network"],
    )

prompt = (
    f"You are a Conscious agent. Given this observation, decide whether "
    f"to propose a high-stake action (transfer/send) or a low-stake "
    f"notification, or no action.\n\n"
    f"Subject: {obs.get('subject') or ''}\n"
    f"Sender:  {obs.get('sender')  or ''}\n"
    f"Summary: {obs.get('summary') or ''}\n\n"
    f"Reply with one of: TRANSFER, NOTIFY, NONE."
)

result = tr.call_transport(ALIAS, prompt, dry_run=DRY_RUN)
verdict = (((result or {}).get("result") or {}).get("text")) or ""

# Heuristic extraction: real LLMs return free-form text; we map to a
# structured intent. In DRY_RUN the bridge echoes our own prompt back
# so parsing the echo would always match — fall back to subject-only
# keywords (matching the deterministic vertical slice). When wired to
# a real LLM, the model's own reply (verdict) drives the decision.
if DRY_RUN:
    lower = (obs.get("subject") or "").lower()
else:
    lower = (verdict + " " + (obs.get("subject") or "")).lower()
intent   = None
if ("transfer" in lower) or ("wire" in lower) or ("urgent" in lower):
    intent = {"capability": "core.transfer_funds", "rationale": "Conscious LLM flagged high-stake action"}
elif ("notify" in lower) or ("calendar" in lower) or ("meeting" in lower) or ("reminder" in lower):
    intent = {"capability": "core.notify", "rationale": "Conscious LLM proposed low-stake nudge",
              "args": {"message": f"Heads up: {obs.get('subject')}"}}

if intent:
    env["intent"] = intent
    env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
        "stage":          "conscious_anticipate_agentic",
        "transport":      ALIAS,
        "dry_run":        DRY_RUN,
        "emitted_intent": intent["capability"],
    })
else:
    env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
        "stage":          "conscious_anticipate_agentic",
        "transport":      ALIAS,
        "dry_run":        DRY_RUN,
        "emitted_intent": None,
    })
output = env
